contract_amendments.summary: standardize coverage.conflicts for multi-sensor value/identity conflicts; unresolved canonical field is null; preserve source/value/grounding_ref

post_amendment_ruling.claim: SMC v0.1 after C28 is sufficient to specify Browser Phase 1, but no Browser adapter implementation has been qualified.

scenarios.contract_reason: 同一 backend/DOM identity 在同 document 内仅重排；合同允许延续 ID，要求可水合 grounding。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: Browser identity tracker 尚未实现。

scenarios.scenario: React rerender replaces node with same role/name
scenarios.contract_reason: 相似语义不证明物理同一；新对象或 unresolved，N14 阻止静默继承旧 ID。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 deterministic fixture 证明替换后不误绑。

scenarios.scenario: duplicate candidates after old node disappears
scenarios.contract_reason: 多个相似候选时 identity ambiguous；不得 best-match 自动重绑。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 2+ 同 role/name 候选 fixture。

scenarios.contract_reason: identity policy 必须预声明且与用户任务文字无关；同 DOM 演化在不同任务下结果相同。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需同一 trace + 不同 task prompt 的 deterministic identity replay。

scenarios.contract_reason: ID runtime/session 唯一且显式 scope_ref，页面内容相同不能导致跨 tab alias。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 page/window scope registry。

scenarios.contract_reason: frame/document 可作为 Browser domain scope hierarchy；frame 导航导致 scope/version 变化，旧 target 不能穿透。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 Browser domain scope spec 明确 page/document/frame parentage。

scenarios.contract_reason: 先判 scope_relation/comparability；新 document 不得解释成旧页面对象全删+新页面全建。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 navigation generation + comparable=false/changed fixture。

scenarios.contract_reason: v0.1 只要求 runtime/session 生命周期；namespace reset 后旧 ID 必须 expired/unavailable，不得碰巧复用。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 runtime_generation/namespace token。

scenarios.scenario: DOM vs AX conflict on canonical state
scenarios.contract_reason: 原合同只写“冲突必须暴露”但无公共 wire；R3 证明 enabled/visible/name 等冲突会迫使跨域调用方猜 extension。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 已以 C28 增加 coverage.conflicts；未消解 canonical field=null，保留每个 source/value/grounding_ref。

scenarios.contract_reason: 同一 DOM node 与多个 AX node、或反向映射不唯一时，不能强行融合成一张卡；原公共 wire 不足。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: C28 同时要求 identity_mapping conflict 显式；不唯一则保留独立对象或 unresolved。

scenarios.contract_reason: 不是“谁为准”，而是 source-qualified observation + coverage/conflict；是否对任务有用由模型判断。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 DOM/AX sensor contract 与字段词汇表。

scenarios.contract_reason: 可达结构进入声明 sensor coverage；closed/unreachable 区域形成 blind_spot，不得静默空集。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 shadow-root scope/coverage fixture。

scenarios.contract_reason: Phase1 可诚实报告 tree blind spot 与 vision capability/cost；不得自动触发 vision。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: Phase1 只需 blind-spot honesty；视觉识别质量不在本项。

scenarios.contract_reason: 视觉对象的稳定 identity、坐标接地精度、遮挡/缩放后的动作安全需真实 Phase2 视觉实验，paper test 不能证明。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: Phase2；v0.1 只固定显式请求、coverage/cost、无自动 vision。

scenarios.scenario: spatial relations from geometry vs inferred grouping
scenarios.contract_reason: 父子/包含/几何 bbox 可机械关系；“看起来同组/更靠近所以相关”仍属模型解释。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 Browser relation vocabulary，只发布可复算 geometry/structure facts。

scenarios.contract_reason: 对象已捕获但未投影 ≠ sensor 没看到；projection 与 completeness 两轴已能表达。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 DOM/AX snapshot pagination/hydrate。

scenarios.contract_reason: dispatch 前必须重新解析 target identity 并核 expected_version；旧 locator 命中替代节点仍应 rejected。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 observe→replace→click race fixture。

scenarios.contract_reason: expected_version + version_scope 能区分 object/resource/snapshot；不支持时明确 unsupported。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 Browser verb/version capability table。

scenarios.contract_reason: 稳定 ID 不等于幂等；non_idempotent/unknown 不得静默 replay。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 transport-failure-after-dispatch fault injection。

scenarios.scenario: click fails after partial side effect
scenarios.contract_reason: atomicity_class 必须如实；single_dispatch/best_effort 失败后仍报告已观察副作用，不能声称世界没变。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 onclick side effect + navigation/error fixture。

scenarios.contract_reason: 动作原 scope 不回写；新 window/download/permission 等以 boundary_events + 新 scope/snapshot 表达。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 popup/download fixture。

scenarios.contract_reason: 同 action_id 的 receipt_seq 单调唯一、旧 receipt immutable；running→terminal 新增 revision。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 现 Browser adapter/append-only receipt store 尚无实现。

scenarios.contract_reason: 未加载/分页区域使“不存在/不可见”缺足够 coverage 时应 indeterminate；正向 witness 可 satisfied。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 virtualized list + scroll coverage fixture。

scenarios.contract_reason: polling unsatisfied 仅表示采样点未见；event_driven 才可声明更强时间语义。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 interval/sample_count/error facts。

scenarios.contract_reason: diff_semantics=snapshot_pair_net 只证明净变化；中间 detach/reattach 不得被说成未发生。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 MutationObserver/event-stream 与 snapshot-pair 对照 fixture。

scenarios.contract_reason: diff comparability 必须含 sensor/coverage contract；DOM-only 与 DOM+AX 不可直接做完整对象集合差。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 sensor_contract/version 纳入 snapshot scope/comparability。

scenarios.scenario: history.pushState URL change in same document
scenarios.contract_reason: document 可保持同 scope，URL/state 作为 mechanically changed field；是否代表任务阶段变化由模型判断。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 same-document navigation fixture。

scenarios.contract_reason: 权限/介质限制进入 coverage/completeness；不可达不能冒充空 frame。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 需 cross-origin frame sensor capability fixture。

scenarios.scenario: native browser chrome / OS permission dialog
scenarios.contract_reason: Browser DOM adapter 不能假装覆盖浏览器 chrome/系统对话框；应报告 blind spot/boundary，实际操控属 Phase3 OS/Computer Use 域。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: Phase3。

scenarios.contract_reason: SMC 实验臂必须禁用模型直连 playwright_exec 或记为 intervention；否则模型可绕过 Semantic ID/receipt contract。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 现 legacy tool 保留为 L1 backend/独立 E2E 资产，不升级为 SMC 模型面。

scenarios.contract_reason: N15 已禁止 ephemeral locator 作为 target_id；CSS/XPath/CDP/AX index 只允许 adapter 内部解析。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: 现 playwright_exec 仍 selector-facing，因此不是 SMC adapter。

scenarios.contract_reason: 核心 P2/P3/N1/N10 已禁止；R3 发现 DESIGN 示例仍有“蓝色主按钮/关键状态/任务相关子集”漂移，已 docs-only 对齐。
scenarios.implementation_or_disposition: Browser adapter 不得生成主按钮/最佳候选/重要性摘要；显式 query/filter 由模型给出。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: surface isolation
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: 声明 smc-manipulation-v0.1；实验臂模型面只暴露 SMC Browser surface。legacy playwright_exec 若保留只作内部 backend/独立 E2E，模型直连必须禁用或计 intervention。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: scope model
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: runtime/session 内 Semantic ID 唯一；显式 page/document/frame scope_ref 与 parent relation；navigation/restart 产生可见 generation/失效事实。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: grounded snapshot
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: WorldSnapshot 绑定 observed_at、sensor_contract、content/integrity grounding、observation completeness 与 projection completeness；DOM/AX raw grounding 可按声明 retention 水合。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: identity continuity
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: identity matcher 任务无关；reorder 同物理对象延续 ID；replacement/duplicate ambiguity 不误绑；旧 ID stale/retired 可机械检测。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: multi-sensor honesty
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: DOM/AX source-qualified；coverage.conflicts 按 C28 输出；未消解冲突 canonical field=null；identity mapping ambiguity 不强融。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: diff semantics
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: SemanticDiff 显式 snapshot_pair_net/event_stream；比较前核 domain/scope/document/sensor contract；incomplete/changed fields 按 field_completeness 诚实降级。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: semantic actions
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: click/fill/select/navigate/scroll 等只接受 Semantic ID/semantic root；model-facing 禁 CSS/XPath/coordinate/CDP/AX index；operation_class 固定于 verb contract。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: TOCTOU/version
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: dispatch 前重新解析 identity + expected_version/version_scope；stale/ambiguous 拒绝，不静默换 locator/target。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: retry/atomicity
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: 每 verb 暴露 idempotency_class/atomicity_class；non_idempotent/unknown transport ambiguity 不 replay；任何允许 retry 都可审计；失败仍报告已观察副作用。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: append-only receipts
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: ActionReceipt 持久可回验；同 action_id receipt_seq 唯一单调；running/terminal revision 不覆盖旧 receipt；before/after version 与 boundary_events 齐全。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: predicate honesty
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: structured Predicate vocabulary；satisfied/unsatisfied/indeterminate；negative 需足够 coverage；polling/event mode、interval/sample/error facts 可见。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: blind spots/boundaries
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: shadow/cross-origin/canvas/native chrome 等不可达显式；new-window/download/dialog/permission 等固定机械事件可见；Phase1 不自动调用 vision。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: authority lint
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: 模型面对象/回执无 recommended/best/priority/completion/recovery sequence/“相似候选自动替代”等策略字段；程序不生成任务相关裁剪或重要性摘要。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: deterministic adversarial suite
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: 至少把 R3-01..R3-32 中 Phase1 非 DEFERRED 场景变成 deterministic fixture；每项有 ground-truth oracle，不依赖 LLM 评分。

browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.name: repo qualification
browser_phase1_minimum_qualification.requirement: focused + adjacent + schema/authority + security + Pyright/Ruff + full ci_gate committed-state 全绿；不得以 legacy Playwright 通过代替 SMC conformance。

legacy_browser_facts.playwright_exec_model_surface: legacy selector/python script surface, not SMC
legacy_browser_facts.axtree_text: CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree flattened text, capped at 500 lines / 20000 chars
legacy_browser_facts.allowed_reuse: L1/backend mechanics and safety assets only; no promotion of selector/index to Semantic ID

non_claims: No Browser SMC production adapter implemented
No live DOM/AX Browser conformance run
No Phase3 native browser chrome/OS UI qualification
